name: Musée National
description: a museum where tourists can learn about the history of Cameroon and its culture, it is a place where you can find a lot of artifacts and traditional items from different regions of the country
bonASavoir: the price is 5000fcfa for adults and 2500fcfa for children, the museum is open from 9am to 5pm every day except on Mondays and can change depending if you're a foreigner
